verdict.rationale: Godot's GitHub repository and license page both state the engine is free and open source under the permissive MIT license. The public source repo at github.com/godotengine/godot, with compilation instructions, confirms the source is readable, and the license explicitly permits use, modification and redistribution. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of browsing and reading the source tree beyond first-party statements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Godot is completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license.
Godot Engine is free and open source software released under the permissive MIT license (also named Expat license).
You can distribute unmodified and changed versions of Godot Engine, even commercially and under a different license (including proprietary)
See the official docs for compilation instructions for every supported platform.
